inputs.external: A JSON rate v1=10, released v2=20 or deliberately wrong40

protocol.calculation: total = external.rate + local.offset; reference uses Python scalar addition and literal expectations 13/23/43, never Spreadsheet
protocol.allowed_actions: install_project, share, publish, adopt, read_object, create_object, write_object, submit, approve
protocol.legal_layouts: One JSON with total and sources; or two whole-field JSON objects {total} and {sources}. Each contributing file declares both exact dependencies. No deep merge.
protocol.maintenance: B predeclares source A selector, analysis lineage, accepted trigger, successor effect, manager revision authority, new goal; actual publication event creates successor without controller revision/install
protocol.exits: Every action/event error fails construction; missing checks are not-executed. A wrong source is an intentional content-negative condition, not a kernel failure.
protocol.comparison_scope: Per-world old submissions/adoptions/observations and all old version bytes; fixed local object; unrelated work records in A and B; actual immutable content and source dependencies
protocol.error_attribution: Wrong upstream40 causes the A content check and overall23 goal to fail; B reporting43 is faithful. This is one injected source error, not two independent worker capability failures.
limits: One world with two projects and single writer per isolated branch
Unrelated work within those projects is checked; no third unrelated project is introduced
Finite linear scalar content with controlled JSON production; mixed XLSX source reading is additionally covered by unit tests
No model/API/GPU/training; this informed driver is distinct from P4 public-only execution

frozen_script.method: Computed from frozen Git blob, not inserted into the original run manifest

omissions: Full calls and observations remain in raw reports; only selected adoption/revision/request commands are included for P1
Full final state, journal, messages and response internals remain in each recorded final-state file
Repeated per-evaluation check.contract objects are omitted; evaluator outcomes, reasons, sources, bindings, read hashes and reviews are retained
Command duration and receipt details are not copied into the summary
